name: application-leaderboard-list
title: Leaderboard List
description: Ranked list of entries with automatic medal badges for the top three ranks, avatars, scores, and up/down/same movement indicators, for gamification or performance leaderboards.
useWhen: Displaying a ranked set of people or entities by score, where relative position matters more than raw tabular data.
You want the top-3 medal styling to apply automatically based on rank, not hand-coded per row.
Showing whether each entry's rank changed since the last period (up/down/no change).
avoidWhen: You need sortable columns or additional per-row data beyond rank/name/score — use a table instead.
Ranking isn't the point — a plain list or avatar-group is simpler if order doesn't matter.
There are more entries than fit comfortably in a scrollable list — paginate or virtualize before reusing this markup.
responsiveBehavior: Rows are a single flex line; on narrow viewports consider hiding the movement indicator or truncating names rather than wrapping the row.
accessibility: The list is a real ordered list (<ol>) so assistive tech announces position and total count.
Movement direction is conveyed by both an arrow icon and a visually hidden text label (Moved up/Moved down/No change), not color or rotation alone.
Medal colors are supplementary — the numeric rank chip is always visible as the primary indicator.

variants.title: Leaderboard list
variants.description: Five-entry weekly leaderboard with medal badges for the top 3, scores, and movement indicators, on a light surface.
accessibility: Score values use toLocaleString for readable grouping (e.g. 9,840).

variants.title: Leaderboard list (Dark)
variants.description: The same five-entry leaderboard, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Medal, avatar, and movement colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
